title: Cardiceas
summary: Raleigh names Cardiceas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Cardiceas, also printed Gardiceas, King of Media after Medidus. Raleigh sayes these two Kings are found in Eusebius, and he reckons them with Ezekia. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
